title: GDPR Gate MVP: Sensitivity, Redaction, DPA, and Cloud Block
objective: Ensure cloud-first execution is blocked when GDPR gate checks fail and deterministic fallback is applied.
acceptance_criteria: Cloud eligibility is explicitly determined from issue sensitivity and compliance metadata.
Redaction and audit requirements are required gate inputs before cloud execution.
When GDPR gate fails, cloud routing is blocked and deterministic fallback is applied.

focus: Restricted or non-compliant cloud-first issues are always blocked.
Fallback lane routing is deterministic on GDPR gate failure.
